preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the MemeFarm contract.
The Uniswap pair for the token must have sufficient BNB and MemeFarm token liquidity for a swap to occur.

exploit_hint: The attacker, who is the contract owner, can exploit their privileges to steal funds from users' sales. The strategy is to first call `setAllTaxes` to set the sell tax to a very high percentage (e.g., 99%). Then, call `setMarketinWalleAddress` and `setTeamWalletAddress` to redirect the collected fees to an attacker-controlled address. Finally, execute a sale of the MemeFarm token from any address on Uniswap. This will trigger the `swapAndLiquify` mechanism, which converts the collected tax tokens into BNB and sends them to the attacker's wallet, draining value from the seller.
